summary:
Plan D (exercise-request coach tasks + roster restart lifecycle) and reassessment micro-form fix validated. Created test_iter77_plan_d_reassessment.py with 16 pytest cases — ALL 16 pass. Regression: Plan A (21) + Plan B (26) → 47/47 still pass. Frontend smoke tests F1/F2/F3 all rendered correctly (screenshots taken). One MINOR frontend concern flagged (see frontend_issues).

T1 hook_exercise_request_task: create → dedup → escalate normal→urgent when a nearer workout is added; NO duplicate tasks; clients_affected / programmes_affected / workouts_affected merged; request_count incremented.
T2 reconcile: orphan draft in exercises_v2 without a task → reconcile creates task with source='reconciliation' and recovered=True.
T3 GET /api/coach/exercise-reviews/counts → correct integer counts for unresolved/needed_soon/urgent/high/media_needed + list endpoint accepts all 4 bucket filters.
T4 GET /api/roster/management → returns active_roster + programme + upcoming_workouts_count + coach_locked_upcoming_count + pending_replacement + versions_total.
T5 POST /api/roster/delete-and-restart (delete_and_future_plan mode): roster.status='deleted_by_client' + is_active=false + deleted_at/deleted_by set; future uncompleted workout deactivated=true, deactivated_reason='roster_deleted'; coach-locked future workout UNTOUCHED; completed past workout UNTOUCHED; programme.status='awaiting_roster' + deactivated=true; gen_jobs → status='cancelled'; users.roster_status='awaiting_roster'; audit_log contains all 6 events (roster.deletion_requested, roster.deactivated, workouts.deactivated, programme.deactivated, gen_jobs.cancelled, roster.deleted); coach_tasks row type='roster_deleted' created with cleanup_summary.
T5b delete_only mode: roster soft-deleted but ALL workouts preserved, programme untouched.
T5 guards: missing typed_delete → 400; confirm=false → 400; no active roster → 400.
T6 Safety guard in server.py L3043-3058 verified via code inspection: re-queries db.rosters and aborts if is_active=false OR status='deleted_by_client'; also aborts if gen_jobs status='cancelled'.
T7 GET /api/reassessment/short-form: all 4 kinds return well-formed questions with correct types and options. missed_workouts.reason has 8 options; energy_level range 1–5; adjust_plan single_select; note long_text optional. roster_uploaded.training_days_per_week options ['2','3','4','5','6']. Unknown kind → 404.
T8 POST /api/reassessment/short-form (roster_uploaded, prompt_id, answers={training_days_per_week:'5', energy_baseline:4}): reassessment_responses row inserted with exact answers; users.profile.training_days_per_week=5 (int); coach_tasks 'reassessment_response' created with rendered description + profile_updates; matching prompt dismissed with resolved_via='short_form'; coaching_dna row count AND content BYTE-IDENTICAL before/after (never touched).

Frontend F1 (/roster/manage as client@crewfit.com): 'Roster Management' header, YOUR ACTIVE ROSTER card (period 2026-08-04→2026-08-08, version #35, 14 upcoming), all 3 action rows (Review or edit / Upload updated / Delete roster and start again) rendered with red destructive styling on Delete. F2 (/reassessment/roster_uploaded?prompt_id=fake_p1): 'Quick availability check' title, intro copy 'You've uploaded a new roster — a 60-second check…', question 'How many days a week can you realistically train this month?' with 2-6 day radio options, range 1-5 for energy_baseline, two optional long_text fields, Send-to-Louis footer button. F3 (/(client)/home for a client with active prompts): MISSED SESSIONS · CHECK-IN card correctly shows the NEW 'QUICK CHECK-IN' label (NOT 'UPDATE DNA') — confirming ctaLabelFor + MICRO_FORM_KINDS wiring works.

ui_bugs.issue: A prompt card titled 'CREWFIT INTELLIGENCE / Roster confirmed — take 90s to update your availability so CrewFit adapts perfectly.' still shows the legacy 'UPDATE DNA →' CTA (not one of the new QUICK CHECK-IN/QUICK UPDATE/QUICK CHECK/DEBRIEF labels). This prompt appears to be a kind that is NOT in MICRO_FORM_KINDS {missed_workouts, life_change, roster_uploaded, event_completed}, so it falls into the default('UPDATE DNA') branch of ctaLabelFor(). If this specific 'roster confirmed' prompt kind is actually 'roster_uploaded', the wiring is broken and it should show 'QUICK CHECK'. Please confirm the exact kind emitted for this card — if it's 'roster_uploaded', route+label are correct at the code level but the kind is being emitted with a different string upstream. Screenshot: /tmp/iter77/f3_home.png.

action_items: Confirm which prompt kind emits the 'CREWFIT INTELLIGENCE / Roster confirmed — take 90s to update your availability' card. If it's roster_uploaded (which is in MICRO_FORM_KINDS), the label bug is upstream (prompt kind string mismatch or a stale prompt using a legacy kind like 'roster_confirmed' or 'dna_refresh'). If it's a different kind (e.g. 'dna_refresh' or 'onboarding_incomplete') the current UPDATE DNA fallback may be intentional — in that case update the copy to something less scary since the launch spec asked to remove the aggressive 'REFRESH DNA' language.

Optional housekeeping (from previous iterations, still present): migrate on_event('startup')/('shutdown') to FastAPI lifespan to eliminate motor 'cannot schedule new futures after interpreter shutdown' log noise at pytest teardown.
critical_code_review_comments: feature_exercise_request_tasks.hook_exercise_request_task correctly bumps existing tasks only (never dupes) and escalates priority via a rank map — verified normal→urgent transition when a nearer workout is added post-creation.

feature_v2_resolver.create_exercise_request_if_missing wiring: the hook is invoked on BOTH the fresh-create path AND the dedup/update path, so bumped-only draft rows still get their coach task escalated. Verified indirectly via T1.

feature_roster_lifecycle._deactivate_future_workouts filters by coach_locked!=True AND completed!=True — verified via T5: coach-locked future + completed past both survived, only the plain future workout was deactivated.

feature_roster_lifecycle audit chain is complete: roster.deletion_requested → roster.deactivated → workouts.deactivated → programme.deactivated → gen_jobs.cancelled → roster.deleted (all 6 rows land in db.roster_audit_log per T5).

server.py L3043-3058 Safety guard (Plan D5) is idempotent and defensive: it re-queries the roster AND the job AFTER LLM generation completes but BEFORE persistence — so a late-completing job cannot repopulate a plan the client deleted mid-generation. Job is set to status='cancelled' with a client-safe message in that case.

feature_reassessment_micro applies ONLY int(training_days_per_week) to users.profile from the roster_uploaded form — coaching_dna is provably untouched (T8 verified full-document equality before/after).

feature_reassessment_micro coach task description renders the human option label (not the id) for single_select/multi_select answers — so Louis sees '5 days' not '5', and the answer trail is readable.

roster/manage.tsx UI: delete confirmation requires typed 'DELETE' AND a mode radio; disabled state on the danger button until typed_delete === 'DELETE'; coach-locked warning box surfaces the count of preserved sessions.
reassessment/[kind].tsx: canSubmit gate requires every non-optional question answered — matches the backend micro-form contract exactly.

MICRO_FORM_KINDS constant in home.tsx must stay in lockstep with the backend MICRO_FORMS dict; both currently list the same 4 kinds. Any drift will silently route the client to /assessment (full DNA rebuild) — worth an integration guard test.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iter77_plan_d_reassessment.py (new — 16 pytest cases, uses direct-motor DB seeding via a single session event loop)

success_rate.frontend: F1 PASS · F2 PASS · F3 PASS for MICRO kinds (missed_workouts label 'QUICK CHECK-IN' correct); one legacy-kind CTA flagged for verification

seed_data_creation: Two ephemeral test users (email test_del_*@crewfit-test.com and test_del2_*@crewfit-test.com) with matching rosters/programmes/workouts/gen_jobs — inserted and DELETED in the same test class (tearDown at end of each test). No residue in coach_tasks, users, rosters, workouts, programmes, gen_jobs, roster_audit_log. TestT1/T2/T8 also insert-then-delete their own exercises_v2 + coach_tasks + reassessment_prompts + reassessment_responses rows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter77 seeds test users via bcrypt directly into db.users then logs them in via /api/auth/login — remember the email validator rejects .local / .test TLDs (use *.crewfit-test.com or similar). The single-loop pattern at top of test_iter77_plan_d_reassessment.py (_LOOP = asyncio.new_event_loop) is required because motor pins to the first loop it sees; each subsequent asyncio.run() call would trip 'Event loop is closed'. Reuse this pattern for future tests that need direct DB access. The 'Safety guard (Plan D5)' block at server.py L3043-3058 was verified via string-match only (not exercised by a live LLM run) — if you need end-to-end coverage, seed a gen_job in status='running', flip the roster to is_active=false mid-flight, then let the fallback persist path run and assert it returned early without inserting workouts.
rca_of_issue: F3 potential CTA-label mismatch: the home screen prompt card labelled 'CREWFIT INTELLIGENCE / Roster confirmed — take 90s to update your availability so CrewFit adapts perfectly.' shows CTA 'UPDATE DNA' instead of 'QUICK CHECK'. Root cause is one of two possibilities: (a) the prompt row in db.reassessment_prompts for that client has kind='dna_refresh' or 'roster_confirmed' (legacy) rather than 'roster_uploaded' — in which case ctaLabelFor() correctly falls through to 'UPDATE DNA' but the source kind is stale, (b) MICRO_FORM_KINDS is missing that kind. Reproduction: log in as client@crewfit.com, open (client)/home, scroll to the roster-confirmed prompt card, observe CTA text. Mitigation: 1. Query db.reassessment_prompts for that client and check kind field; 2. If kind='roster_uploaded' — the client's home.tsx should be showing 'QUICK CHECK', investigate why ctaLabelFor is not resolving; 3. If kind is different — either migrate legacy prompts to roster_uploaded OR add the legacy kind name into MICRO_FORM_KINDS + MICRO_FORMS dict (backend) with the intended short-form, OR soften the copy so 'UPDATE DNA' no longer appears at all as the spec suggests.
